limitations: Typed Vanilla HUD: title/subtitle/actionbar, item hotbar, boss bars, sidebar, effect icons and player-list text; other HUD and third-party render overrides remain unsupported

Selected item name and hotbar durability/cooldown are completed native HUD draws, bound to world/camera/Screen/GUI size for 250 ms; bars expose drawn pixel extents, not raw damage or remaining cooldown ticks

Experience/jump/locator entries describe only actual native contextual-bar sprites and the drawn experience-level label; no raw experience points, vehicle charge/cooldown, waypoint identity or world position is returned

Crosshair/attack indicators and camera overlays are completed native draw submissions; attack bars expose only drawn pixel extents, overlays expose their transformed viewport-clipped bounding rectangle and submitted opacity, not final texture pixels or hidden player state. Native F1 and Screen occlusion remain in force; the actually drawn sleep overlay may be presented with its InBedChatScreen

Boss color/notch sprites and late GUI text are actual completed native draw submissions. GUI text observes native pose, opacity and scissor; partially clipped lines expose only bounds/phase, not their hidden characters. The late frame is world/camera/Screen/Overlay/size bound for 250 ms, capped at 128 nodes and reset before every native GUI extraction; no chat cache, raw effect/player-list state or F3 server-chunk request is read

Player list USER rows come from completed native name/header/footer, ping and formatted-score/heart draws; no profile identity, exact latency, raw scores or skins. An independent 80-row frame permits up to 64 submitted parts per row, without enlarging the 128-node late-text budget. Context, native visibility and 250 ms age are checked on read; hidden native rows remain DEBUG-only
Effect icon opacity comes from the last completed native draw at the same player/Screen/GUI size, no older than 250 ms; no amplifier/duration or third-party draw guarantee

Toast text: System/Tutorial/Advancement/Recipe from native render callbacks; Friend/NowPlaying from text actually submitted within their resident native draw; no queued text or music/friends-service internal state in USER

USER Toast text requires a fully shown, wholly viewport-contained completed native sample, bound to the same Toast/world/camera/Screen/Overlay/GUI size for 250 ms. Partial entering/exiting Toasts expose only clipped bounds and render phase, without hidden text; this is not a framebuffer or third-party rendering guarantee

Friend/NowPlaying require a completed resident draw within 250 ms at the same Toast/world/camera/Screen/GUI size; entering/exiting report the native phase and viewport-clipped background bounds without partial text. Full labels require a fully shown, wholly viewport-contained draw; static settings previews are not resident Toast samples

Vital icons are the ordered native glyph composition, including container/blinking/foreground layers; no raw health, food, air, saturation or mount statistics. The completed sample is world/camera/Screen/size bound, expires after 250 ms and fails closed beyond 256 glyphs; third-party draw replacement and final pixel occlusion are not guaranteed.
